key_idea: the distance from a point to a plane can be computed by finding the magnitude of the projection of the vector from the origin to the point onto the plane's normal, and comparing it with the distance of the plane to the origin along that normal

elements.element: large left curly brace spanning the distance between p and the plane along n, labelled d
elements.role: the double underline under the d hints that this is the central concept of the sketch. It is the distance from the plane to the point p via the vector normal n to the plane.
